note: A ring written closed (SPEC 3.7). A ring is stored open, and a last position repeating the first is one fact written twice, so the reader drops the repeat and keeps the area: nothing is lost. The diagnostic is kept anyway, so that a writer that closes its rings can be seen, and it names the dropped position by its index as written. `counts` pins four positions: a reader that kept the repeat has five, and one that dropped the area has none. `positions` pins the last surviving position, so a reader that dropped the FIRST position instead fails.

diagnostics.message_advisory: the last position repeats the first — it is dropped
